conclusions.trpo_free: Exploration-scale mismatch: default log_std_init=0 (4.7x larger noise than PPO family) destroys the solvable residual prior within <10k steps; even 500k (3.3x budget) never recovers (all checkpoints 0.000, 2 seeds). Matched init (-1.5) rescues the start (0.80@10k) but conservative CG updates then erode it (0.80->0.36->0.04).
conclusions.trpo_seq: Structural failure: even with matched init, seq TRPO is 0.000 at every checkpoint — the three-phase hold+geometry criteria amplify any policy-mean error; TRPO cannot preserve the near-optimal zero prior on the sequential task.
conclusions.rnd: Direction conflict, not scale: intrinsic-weight ablation (0.5 vs 0.05, both tasks) yields 0.000 across the board — the single-value-head simplification lets novelty reward structurally fight the hold-window criteria regardless of weight.
